tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body desire-1 visual-novel sprite of Faruzan. Use the supplied approved neutral as the sole image reference. Give her a tender longing expression and open eyes, a subtle shy tilt and one hand near her collarbone; allow a genuinely different pose appropriate to the emotion. Both eyes visibly open; preserve the original irises and their colour and detail, with filled white heart-shaped pupils inside the irises, not floating symbols or catchlights. Her skirt and fabric panels hang naturally downward at rest; no windblown fabric. Keep gestures simple, hands near the torso with coherent palms and naturally grouped fingers, exactly two legs and feet, with feet separated or slightly staggered. Show the entire silhouette including hair, accessories and shoes, with roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Genuinely transparent background.
